verdict.rationale: The evidence pack is dominated by marketing copy (flow state, crystal-clear Bluetooth, etc.) rather than a real spec sheet; only one item gives a concrete number (up to 48 TOPS NPU) but without test conditions, and clocks, power envelope, and memory support are never specified. missing for 10: base/boost clock speeds, TDP/power figures, memory support (type/speed/capacity), TOPS test methodology/conditions, independent corroboration of specs.
